basic_info.description: Exquisite one-bedroom condominium in prime Pacific Heights! On a tree-lined block lined with mansions and behind a classic faade, this gorgeous home showcases period details blended seamlessly with modern upgrades. The inviting living room features treetop outlooks through bay windows and beautiful wall paneling and crown moldings, flowing into a formal dining room ideal for elegant entertaining.  A fantastic chef's kitchen has been meticulously renovated with quartz countertops and backsplash, a Bertazzoni gas range and hood, Bosch dishwasher, Liebherr refrigerator, and custom open shelving and cabinetry. The generous bedroom is filled with light from large windows overlooking the street, and two closets. Adjacent is a luxurious marble bathroom outfitted with a double floating vanity and a glass-enclosed shower. Upgrades include in-unit laundry, hardwood flooring, new custom windows throughout and great closet space. This elegant elevator building has been extensively updated and offers a common garden, as well as one-car garage parking and private storage for this unit. Located 2.5 blocks from the entrance to the Presidio, with miles of trails and greenery, and walkable to Alta Plaza Park, Presidio Playground, and neighborhood cafes, shops and restaurants.
